notes.title: FREE DLC Available Soon & Patch Notes Update!
notes.notes:
Hi guys! A major DLC of Castle Morihisa will be available for free soon!

In this new patch, you'll be able to play Miko, a brand-new class with unique battle style and various stategy combinations inspired by the ever-changing lunar phase. 

And you could take a peek at Miko's preview in the game now! Please stay tuned!

In the meantime, please check out these following adjustments we made to balance the game. 

1. "Healthy"has been replaced by "Potential" in Common Talent.
Potential:When you exhaust your action points for the first time on your turn, reduce the action point cost of 1 random card(s) in your hand to 0 for this turn.
2. "Perfect Deliberation"'s efffect has been replaced by "For each Tactic card you play, draw 1 Tactic card(s) and reduce the action point cost by 1 for this turn." in Common Talent.
3. Golem's buff "Bulwark"'s effect has been changed from "Is immune to all attacks that deal less than 6 damage." to "Is immune to all attacks that deal less than 4 damage."
4.Terror Arachnid's health has been changed from "76" to "50".
5. Black Treant's health has been changed from "72" to "60".
6. Ghost Lantern's health has been changed from "68" to "54".
7. Demon Soldier's health has been changed from "88" to "65".
8. Giant Toad's health has been changed from "48" to "40".
9. Archer's health has been changed from "30" to "25".
10. Ghost Lantern's base damage has been changed from "10" to "6".
11. Carrion Raven's buff "Dive"'s damage has been changed from "12" to "9".
12. Spearman's armor has been changed from "5" to "4".
13. Lethal Snakes' buff "Poison Fang"'s damage has been changed from "5" to "4",and its "Attack"'s times has been changed from "3" to "2".
14. Fleshworm Spawn's health has been changed from "25" to "20".
15. Fleshworm Egg's health has been changed from "38" to "30".
16. When Fleshworm dies, only one Fleshworm Spawn will be summoned.
17. Difficulty VI's effect has been changed from "Enemies have 2 more strength." to "Enemies have 1 more strength."
18. Hattori Hanzo's effect has been changed by "If an enemy has 20 health or less, ignore their armor and deal 20 damage."
19. Fixed several game bugs.

Thank you all so much for your support! Join our Discord to send us feedback and have a chat!
[url=https://discord.gg/2FZVprUb2a]https://discord.gg/2FZVprUb2a[/url]

notes.title: Castle Morihisa Patch Notes 1.0.81
notes.notes:
Hi warriors! Thanks for playing Castle Morihisa! Please check out some more adjustments we made to balance the game. If you didn’t get the notifications for the update, please restart the Steam client.

Castle Morihisa Patch Notes 1.0.81

1. New artifacts!! 
Miso: Restores 5 health when you pick up a quest scroll.
Key: Grants a 50% chance to get 1 card reward when you open a chest.
Dried Plum: Restores 3 health when you unlock a talent.
Treasure Map: Grants 20% extra coins when you win a battle.
Rations: Increases your maximum health by 5 when you defeat an elite enemy.
Rice Hat: Grants 1 extra talent point when you buy talent points in the shop.
Incense: Restores 1 charge of a random fallen hero whenever you rest at a camp.
Rain Doll: Restores 1 charge of a random fallen hero when you complete a random event.
2. Fixed the attack error of the Gunner.
3. Fixed the bugs of Master Ninja when defeated.
4. Fixed several bugs that might cause crashes.

notes.title: Castle Morihisa Patch Note 1.0.78
notes.notes:
Card Adjustments
1.Monk card “Buddha's Grace+”: Reduced health recovery from 10 to 8.
2.Monk card “Asura”: Increased gained strength from 1 to 2; “Asura+”: Increased gained strength from 2 to 3.
3.Ninja card “Bulging Bag”: Increased card cost from 0 to 1, draw 2 item cards.
4.Ninja card “Phantom Step”: The original damage changed to 2; “Phantom Step+”: The original damage changed to 3. Removed Foresight.
5.Ninja card “Bide Time”: Removed Discard effect.
6.Monk card “Benevolence”: Changed image assets. 

Hero Adjustment
1.Hero “Hattori Hanzo”: Changed to “Execute an enemy with 20 health or less.”

Talent Adjustment
1.General talent “Healthy”: Enlarged maximum health increase from 10 to 15.

Enemy Adjustments
1.Elite Heretic: Decreased its health from 100 to 80; Decreased its basic damage from 8 to 6.
2.Elite Heretic: Removed “Life Barrier” ability.
3.Heretic: Decreased its health from 85 to 60; Decreased its basic damage from 12 to 8.
4.Dark Sacrifice: Decreased the damage of “Hex” from 14 to 8.
5.Fleshworm: Decreased its health from 142 to 120.
6.Carrion Raven: Decreased its health from 32 to 26.
7.Demon Soldier: Decreased its basic damage from 6 to 4.
8.Black Treant: Decreased its health from 82 to 72; Decreased its basic damage from 10 to 6.
9.Black Treant: Decreased Retaliation from 5 to 3; Decreased Armor (gained for each turn) from 5 to 4. 
10.Corpsehound: Decreased its basic damage from 4 to 3.
11.Demonspawn: Decreased its basic damage from 4 to 3.

Others
1.Reduced waiting time of enemies behaviors.
2.Corrected some text errors.
3.Changed English font.
4.Fixed several bugs that might cause crashes.
5.Talent tree: All talents will be visible from the beginning of each round.

Thank you for playing Castle Morihisa! Please rest assured that all your suggestions are well received and we will continue fixing game issues and optimizing the game balance. If you have any questions regarding our game, please feel free to leave us a message. 

Join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/2FZVprUb2a]https://discord.gg/2FZVprUb2a[/url]

notes.title: Castle Morihisa 1.0.77 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Castle Morihisa! 
We have read through all of your feedback and suggestions and these are really important to us. However, it will take us some time to come up with better plans to balance the game and do rounds of testing. For the time being, we will fix bugs that affect gameplay and get to the game balance soon. Thanks for your understanding and support!

New Updates
1. Fixed the bug of events where one cannot choose to donate certain coins or sacrifice HP in exchange of rewards.
2. Fixed the bug that one cannot check the upgraded version of the card [Divination+].
3. Added more tips of enemies’ current status.
More descriptions of effects will now appear in the monsters’ intentions for better understanding.
4. Optimized texts.
